landing.heroSubtitle: Automated micro-savings locked until your goal is reached. Only your chosen Keyholder can unlock it early.
landing.howItWorksSub: Three dead-simple steps between your urge and your future.
landing.step1Desc: Choose what you are saving for—a Japan trip, new phone, or safety net. Pick an amount and schedule that fits your cash flow.
landing.step2Desc: Small micro-amounts are auto-pulled on your salary or allowance day into your locked vault. You won't feel the pinch.
landing.step3Desc: Pick a trusted Keyholder. If you try to break the lock early, you must write an excuse and they must approve it on WhatsApp.
landing.approvalSub: When impulse hits, your friend receives an instant alert with an AI reality check before they decide.
landing.mockupAlertBody: Abdulrahman wants to unlock his 'Japan Summer Trip' vault early (125.000 KWD).
landing.mockupExcuseText: Found a limited sneaker drop at 360 Mall.
landing.mockupAiText: Bro, you already have 14 pairs of sneakers at home. Hold the line for Tokyo!
landing.mockupRejectedFeedback: Good call! Kept locked. Abdulrahman's 18-day streak is saved.
landing.finalCtaHeading: Lock your future. Break the impulse.
landing.finalCtaSub: Join youth across Kuwait taking control of their money without banking nonsense.
